name: Shin Koihime † Musou -Kakumei- Souten no Haou
original_name: 真・恋姫†夢想-革命- 蒼天の覇王
source:
Gi version of the Shin Koihime † Musou - Kakumei series. The Kakumei series aim to deepen the story of Gi, Go and Shoku in a restart from 0 with new scenes and stories for existing and new heroines routes. 24 new characters announced(some of them already made debut on Eiyuutan series) for a total of 73 heroines, over 200 CGs, more historical battles from the Three Kingdoms and battle system reworked also it was announced that some  Seiyuu(Voice Actor) will be different from the previous versions totaling at least 50.000 voiced words and over 75 Voice Actors.

With the Nexton-Passport you have access to additional exclusive content.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://baseson.nexton-net.jp/kakumei-gi/concept/index.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
真恋姬 † 无双 - 觉明系列的Gi版本。《觉明》系列旨在从0重新开始，深化《道》、《围》和《食》的故事，为现有和新的女主角路线提供新的场景和故事。宣布了24个新角色（其中一些已经在英雄联盟系列中首次亮相），总共73个女主角，超过200个CG，更多来自三个王国的历史战斗和重新设计的战斗系统，还宣布一些声优（声优）将与以前的版本不同，总计至少50.000语音和超过75名声优。

使用Nexton-Passport，你可以访问其他独家内容。

[大致翻译自[url=http://baseson.nexton-net.jp/kakumei-gi/concept/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
